_: Phase L. Every assertion added to test_ui_now.py in v3.16.0, and how each
one was SEEN to fail. Read tools/NEGATIVE_CONTROL.py for why this file
control 'version' -- the assertion fails against the reconstructed
v3.15.0, which the patcher regenerates with --reverse.
control 'mutation' -- the assertion guards a property v3.15.0 ALREADY
had, so a version diff cannot make it fail. Those properties are broken
on purpose in a copy of the current app instead, which is the stronger
control anyway: it shows the assertion responds to the specific thing it
min_hits is for family entries, where the name is a substring shared by
the six tabs at one width and theme. One of six failing would not show
that the other five are being measured at all.
